eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 12:11 AM on AUG 15, 2023 Effective until 10:11 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Mesa Police Department is looking for 85-year-old Marylin Francine Powell. Marylin is a black female, 5 feet 4 inches tall, 178 pounds, with blue eyes and brown hair. Marylin has brown cornrows hair style. She was last seen wearing a red long sleeve shirt with unknown logo on the front and pink sweatpants. Marylin was last seen leaving her house on August 14th, 2023, around 5:45 p.m. driving a 2002 Suzuki, Grand Vitara with the Arizona License plate A R Z 3 6 8 6. Marylin suffers from a medical condition which may cause her to become confused and easily lost. If you have seen or have any information please contact the Mesa Police Department. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
